verdict.rationale: Warp's docs say its Schedules feature runs recurring tasks such as dependency updates or dead code removal. Cloud agents can run in the background, triggered by schedules, system events or integrations. Each run is tracked and has an inspectable transcript. missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule configuration (cron syntax, frequency options, management via CLI/API), recurring scheduling of Warp Drive workflows (not just agent tasks), independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled runs work.
